customService.title: 非标自动化装备定制服务
customService.description: 我们的研发实力不仅限于标准规格三维编织设备，还可以为您的异形三维编织件（如高压氢气储罐、飞机机翼骨架等）定制专属的自动生产线和控制轨迹。
customService.descriptionEn: Our R&D capabilities extend beyond standard 3D braiding equipment. We can also customize dedicated automated production lines and control trajectories for your specialized 3D braided components such as high-pressure hydrogen tanks and aircraft wing frames.
